body:
Triage first-touch: promoted to queue, type Task, as the **deliberate batch** the card asks for — not 33 self-dispatched one-liners. Scope: work the 33-row worklist gate by gate; for each, either declare the subtree spelling beside the constant + pin the coupling in that gate's own self-test (the #10114/#10314 precedent), or record a reasoned won't-declare — the per-gate judgment is exactly the "does naming this gate for every `packages/**` card help or spam dispatch prompts" question, and the recorded declines are part of the deliverable. ⛔ Constraints from the card, binding: no change to `hintCovers`' `:920` refusal; no new recognizer heuristic in `dispatch-gates.mjs` (the 73-pair wider sweep stays unbuilt). Sequencing: same territory as #10705 / PR #10839 (the visible-half ledger) — coordinate with that landing, prefer dispatch after #10839 merges so the ledger idiom is settled. Size/model suggestion: M–L, opus.

**⚠️ Every number on this card is stale and the agent is told to re-measure.** The card was measured on `a7ea3289eb`; `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` has moved three times since — PR #10839 (the ledger), PR #10873 (gates declare a scan surface), and PR #10890 (merged 16:23Z), which **emptied `ESCAPABLE_LITERAL_LEDGER` entirely**. So the visible half this card contrasts itself against is now zero rows, not two, and the family count is no longer 128.

That last one matters for how this card reads: PR #10890's ledger comment now says in the file itself that an empty ledger is **not** "the species is gone", and points here — *"#10840 measures the other half at ~33 gates whose population literal carries no separator at all; those are invisible to the derivation AND to this ledger."* This card is the named successor, not a loose follow-up.

**The deliverable this card asks for is the WORKLIST and its TRIAGE, not 33 fixes.** Its own words: *"What is missing is the worklist"* and *"this wants triage as a batch, not 33 self-dispatched one-liners."* ⛔ And it is explicit that the naive wider sweep (73 pairs across 52 families) must not become a ledger — that would re-introduce the +139084 fabrication one level up.

⛔ Not a request to loosen `hintCovers`' bare-literal refusal. The card says so; so does the dispatch.

If an earlier claim comment with a different session ID appears above this one, that claim wins and this one is void.
